source: scripts/development-ledger/gate0_red_team.py with gate0_runtime_attacks.py — the internal adversarial battery of GATE 0 — FOUNDATION, executed against the delivery

baselineControl.detail:
the unmutated fixture is accepted by every control this battery mutates: the application accepts its own configuration (configuration loads, health=UP, version=0.0.0-test); redaction leaves a clean message alone (connected to db:5432 in 35ms); the scope control accepts the real tree (no violation); the infrastructure suite accepts the real compose file (..................
----------------------------------------------------------------------
Ran 18 tests in 0.657s

OK)

attacks.description: A permissive CORS wildcard reaches the running API.
attacks.mutation: IACODE_CORS_ALLOW_ORIGINS='*'
attacks.expectedDefense: the configuration refuses to load and names the wildcard
attacks.observed: Value error, IACODE_CORS_ALLOW_ORIGINS may not contain '*'; list the exact origins [type=value_error, input_value=['*'], input_type=list]
attacks.origin: GATE-0 internal Red Team, executed in the API image

attacks.description: A synchronous database URL silently blocks the event loop.
attacks.mutation: IACODE_DATABASE_URL without the asyncpg driver
attacks.expectedDefense: the configuration refuses to load and names the driver
attacks.observed: Value error, IACODE_DATABASE_URL must use the postgresql+asyncpg driver, found 'postgresql' [type=value_error, input_value='postgresql://iacode:iacode@db:5432/iacode', input_type=s
attacks.origin: GATE-0 internal Red Team, executed in the API image

attacks.description: A scheme in the object-storage endpoint produces a client that builds broken URLs.
attacks.mutation: IACODE_MINIO_ENDPOINT='http://minio:9000'
attacks.expectedDefense: the configuration refuses at start-up rather than on the first object call
attacks.observed: Value error, IACODE_MINIO_ENDPOINT is host:port without a scheme; use IACODE_MINIO_SECURE [type=value_error, input_value='http://minio:9000', input_type=str]
attacks.origin: GATE-0 internal Red Team, executed in the API image

attacks.description: An invalid enumerated configuration value is accepted.

attacks.description: A default credential ships inside the application.

attacks.description: A credential reaches a log record through the message.
attacks.mutation: log a DSN in the message and a secret key in the structured context
attacks.expectedDefense: both are replaced with [REDACTED] while the host stays readable
attacks.observed: redacted; host preserved as 'minio'
attacks.origin: GATE-0 internal Red Team, executed in the API image

attacks.description: An unhandled exception returns its traceback to the caller.

attacks.expectedDefense: the response carries a stable code and a correlation id, and no internal detail
attacks.observed: HTTP 500; code=INTERNAL_ERROR correlationId present
attacks.origin: GATE-0 internal Red Team, executed in the API image

attacks.description: A caller controls what is written into our logs and headers.

attacks.observed: all three replaced, e.g. 01a0c685-ae66-7000-a4c9-...
attacks.origin: GATE-0 internal Red Team, executed in the API image

attacks.description: Readiness reports READY while no dependency is reachable.
attacks.mutation: run the application against addresses where nothing is listening
attacks.expectedDefense: readiness answers 503 NOT_READY with every dependency DOWN while liveness stays UP
attacks.observed: ready=HTTP 503 NOT_READY, health=UP, 4 dependencies reported
attacks.origin: GATE-0 internal Red Team, executed in the API image

attacks.description: A driver error puts the database password in the readiness payload.

attacks.expectedDefense: the failure detail is redacted before it reaches the response
attacks.observed: the failure detail is redacted
attacks.origin: GATE-0 internal Red Team, executed in the API image

attacks.description: A dependency that never answers makes readiness hang forever.
attacks.mutation: a probe that sleeps for an hour
attacks.expectedDefense: readiness bounds the probe and answers DOWN within the configured timeout
attacks.observed: answered in 1.0s with DOWN
attacks.origin: GATE-0 internal Red Team, executed in the API image

attacks.description: The version endpoint becomes a diagnostics dump.

attacks.description: A credential hides at depth under a key nothing enumerates.

attacks.origin: GATE-0 internal Red Team, executed on the host

attacks.description: Redaction destroys the log it was supposed to protect.
